stock.description: SH Group (Holdings) Limited operates as an investment holding entity, providing electrical and mechanical (E&M) engineering solutions to both public sector and commercial clients across Hong Kong. Its services encompass the supply, installation, and ongoing maintenance of mechanical ventilation and air-conditioning systems. The company also offers expertise in low voltage electrical systems and various other E&M disciplines, including fire suppression, as well as plumbing and drainage networks. The firm was established in 1986 and maintains its principal office in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
